1879073224.Skill_Desc: Your companion makes a wild and damaging attack.

1879073480.Skill_Desc: Your skill as a hobbit allows you to find a path back to The Shire. This skill is easily interrupted.

1879099080.Skill_Desc: You can instruct someone how to play the harp.

1879102536.Skill_Desc: Share Stealth with one ally while remaining within 5m of one another.

1879104840.Skill_Desc: Douse opponent with corrosive liquid that weakens their armour and releases a soporific gas that reduces Fate, Tactical Mastery, Armour, Resistance, and Finesse.

1879130696.Skill_Desc: A close-ranged attack that will hit multiple targets.

1879136968.Skill_Desc: A spinning attack that can damage multiple targets around you.

1879160008.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available from Rûsu, the Lossoth Reward Vendor.

1879164104.Skill_Desc: Direct your Soldier to engage the selected foe.

1879212104.Skill_Desc: It's a bit redundant to call these 'Gross Bugs' as all bugs are inherently gross.

1879213896.Skill_Desc: Your Fellowship strikes at Draigoch's scales, tearing them loose and exposing what lies beneath.

1879217096.Skill_Desc:
A healing stance, wherein the Minstrel's restorative abilities are at their finest.<rgb=#FF7700>

Major Ballad becomes a healing Ballad.

Echoes of Battle Becomes The Melody of Battle.

Coda of Melody becomes Coda of Resonance.</rgb>

Only one Stance may be active at a time.

1879242312.Skill_Desc:
<rgb=#66fff>Mounted Discipline</rgb>

Mounted Disciplines are used to alter the attitude and tactics used by your War-steed in Mounted Combat.

<rgb=#66ffff>Rohirrim</rgb>

The Rohirrim Discipline allows the Lore-master to turn their attention to the elements and natural aspects of the world around them.

1879245640.Skill_Desc: A quick reflection on the power of words yields a damaging or inspiring effect to the Rune-keeper's enemies or allies.

1879250760.Skill_Desc:
Using your knowledge of fire and all that burns, you heave handfuls of pitch soaked embers at your target. They burn hotter and hotter over time.

When your companion has Flanked the enemy, this skill will deal additional damage. <rgb=#FF7700>

The effects from this skill can stack up to 3 times.</rgb>

1879271240.Skill_Desc: Deals AoE damage in front of the Champion.\n\nDamage is increased by 30% per pip consumed.

1879271752.Skill_Desc: Deals damage and stuns surrounding enemies.\n\nApplies Guardian debuffs and some bleeds to affected targets.

1879272264.Skill_Desc:
Grants additional effects to the following skills: 

 Sustaining Bolt: Restores more Morale 
 Writ of Lightning: Applies max rank of debuff and builds double Battle Attunement 
 Epic Conclusion: Leaves a trailing DoT for a portion of the damage dealt 
 Shocking Words: Becomes AoE and slows targets for 5s after being stunned.
 
 Cannot be cast out of combat.

1879276104.Skill_Desc: Every strike against you will cause your attackers pain.

1879277000.Skill_Desc: A tripwire trap can knock a monster down, creating the opportunity to use a Fellowship Manoeuvre.\n\nTrap remains for 1 minute after being placed.

1879295432.Skill_Desc: A tripwire trap can knock a monster down, sometimes creating the opportunity to use a Fellowship Manoeuvre.\n\nTrap remains for 1 minute after being placed.

1879302600.Skill_Desc: You enlist a Herald to carry your Banner of Hope into battle. This banner increases the mitigations of those around it.
1879302600.Skill_Name: Call to Arms: Herald of Hope (Oath-bound)

1879315144.Skill_Desc: When given time to prepare, a Warden can deliver a powerful opening volley.\n\n<rgb=#00FFDD>Mounted Combat Enemies: Knockout replaced with a mount turn rate debuff</rgb>

1879316040.Skill_Desc:
<rgb=#66fff>Mounted Discipline</rgb>

Mounted Disciplines are used to alter the attitude and tactics used by your War-steed in Mounted Combat.

<rgb=#66ffff>Rohirrim</rgb>

The Rohirrim Discipline turns your focus to steeling yourself against the enemy's attack, drawing their ire and defending your allies from enemy assaults.

1879316168.Skill_Desc: Summons a pond frog to keep you company.
1879316168.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available for barter from Roving Threats.

1879368648.Skill_Desc: Brings out a blue peacock to keep you company.
1879368648.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available through barter during the Farmers Faire Festival.

1879385800.Skill_Desc: Brings out a fiery yellow beetle to keep you company.
1879385800.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available from the Skirmishes -- Ill Omens event.

1879391432.Skill_Desc: You enlist a Herald to carry your Banner of War into battle. This banner increases the damage dealt by those around it.
1879391432.Skill_Name: Call to Arms: Herald of War (Elvish Maid-at-arms)

1879411400.Skill_Desc: A strong punch that generates Mettle.\n\nSinister Set-up: If a Sinister Cross is the most recent Set-up Attack used, the next Mettle Spender will tier-up any available Innate Strength buffs twice instead of once. If no Innate Strength buffs have been unlocked via Trait Set Bonuses, this has no effect.

1879411784.Skill_Desc: Unwilling to acknowledge even debilitating injuries, Brawlers often focus on developing the willpower to fight through normally insurmountable pain.\n\nRemoves Fears, Diseases, Poisons, and Wounds from yourself.

1879451336.Skill_Desc: Remind your foes of the doom of the North Kingdoms, dealing massive frost damage after a brief delay.

1879455560.Skill_Desc: Summons a spooky barrow-lurker to scare off your enemies.
1879455560.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available as a reward in Sarch Vorn, the Black Grave.

1879460552.Skill_Desc: Returns you and your Fellowship to Carn Dûm.\n\nThis skill is easily interrupted.

1879476808.Skill_Desc: Summons a lion cub to accompany you on your journeys.
1879476808.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available for barter from The Order of the Eagle Allegiance Rewards Quartermaster in Umbar.

1879486024.Skill_Desc: Summons a Bog-guardian companion.\n\nThe Bog-guardian excels at dealing damage from range.

1879495368.Skill_Desc: A Memory of Mercy can be used to shield an ally, assuming some of their damage yourself.

1879528264.Skill_Desc: Using fell knowledge and potions, breathe a gout of flame in front of you.
